title: Trinity Execution Lease
description: Kernel-issued authority token for a single executor invocation. Cf. .ai/cli/core/executor.py ExecutionLease dataclass and TRINITY_ORGAN_MAP_V1.md §6. Article XVI Least Authority: the lease pins step scope + allowed paths + audit-event closure so the executor cannot widen its authority surface during execution.

lease_id.description: ULID-shaped opaque identifier; unique per session.

step_id.description: Step identifier within the plan (e.g. 'S1', 'S2'). Lease authority is scoped to this single step — Article XVI.

expires_at.description: RFC3339 UTC hard deadline. Executor MUST stop work after expiry; lease re-issue requires explicit Kernel transition.

allowed_paths.description: Strict allowlist of filesystem paths the executor may write during this lease (relative to project root). Sandbox profile (Phase 7) enforces at IO time.

allowed_audit_event_types.description: Subset of TRINITY_AUDIT_EVENT_SPEC_V1 §3 registry the executor is permitted to cause-to-be-emitted during this lease. Default: ALLOWED_AUDIT_EVENT_TYPES from executor.py.

required_artifacts.description: Artifact filenames the executor MUST produce by lease expiry. Default: REQUIRED_OUTPUT_ARTIFACTS (4-file canonical set).

sandbox_profile_ref.description: Optional path to the Phase 7 sandbox profile JSON binding this lease.

decided_by.description: Pinned to 'kernel' — leases are kernel-issued (Article XV: only Authority organs grant authority). The executor MUST NOT mint its own lease.
